question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

We always love to get the __updated__ version of gadgets we use.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Latest'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the underlined word is: '**Latest'.**
 
• The word **'Updated'** means **made more modern or up to date.(अद्यतन)**
 
 
• **Example**:* **They haven't updated the software in three years.*
 
 
 
• The word '**Latest**' means **the most recent.(नवीनतम)**
 
 
• **Example**: *Have you read her latest book?*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: '**Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**: **'****Refurbished**' means made to look new again by work such as painting, repairing, and cleaning.(ठीक करके नए जैसा बनाया गया)
 
• **Option 3**: '**Corrected'** means to show or tell someone that something is wrong and to make it right.(संशोधित)
 
• **Option 4**: '**Old'** means belonging to past or no longer young.(पुराना)
